system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global 16-day composite vegetation indices (NDVI and EVI) from Terra MODIS at 500m resolution covering all vegetated land areas.

data_description.temporal_coverage: 16-day vegetation index time series from 2000 to present (2026).
data_description.important_note: This description is grounded in the local community-catalog index and cached project documentation. Runtime metadata such as exact band schema, spatial resolution, coordinate system, and collection length should be verified during task execution before quantitative analysis.
analytical_capabilities: Drought impact on vegetation health assessment
Seasonal vegetation dynamics and climate coupling
Vegetation feedback to surface energy balance through albedo and evapotranspiration

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI) as dimensionless ratios; values typically range from -1 to 1 with scale factor 0.0001; confirm runtime scaling before analysis.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: NDVI and EVI values require scale factor application (multiply by 0.0001); negative values indicate water/snow, near-zero is bare soil, and high positive values indicate dense vegetation.

data_description.data_source: NASA LP DAAC at USGS EROS Center via Google Earth Engine
